title: MYheroes
description: I'll add my own character, which I created using Palladium, to your game.
body: Myheroes is a superhero I created myself. If lightning strikes your head in rainy weather, it gives you superpowers that can be turned on and off. The "abilities_1" key activates and deactivates them, providing full body protection and 1 or 2 effects, including laser eyes, the ability to grab mobs with two hands, and "abilities_5" for aiming. After aiming, you can shoot laser-like beams using the right and left mouse buttons. It also changes your name to CerniX and alters your appearance.
